messages.subject: Error on loading app in glimmer. How can  diagnose?
parts:
Hi
  I am getting an error  on an app I am developing
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/pssguy/CRAN/

The page (which takes a time loading probably due to populating selectInput) shows but 
I then get error box

``The application unexpectedly exited
Diagnostic information has been dumped to the javascript error console``

When I call up the javascript console in Chrome and press the error tab nothing shows

The app works fine locally

messages.subject: Re: Error on loading app in glimmer. How can diagnose?
parts: The problem was that the file CRANpackages.csv was encoded using ISO-8859-1; that's what Windows expects, but on Linux by default the encoding is expected to be UTF-8. I added a fileEncoding argument to the read.csv call in global.R and it seems to work fine now.

messages.subject: Re: Error on loading app in glimmer. How can diagnose?
parts:
Thanks for that Joe. I would never have solved it
Couple of follow up points
 a) I have had no such problems with other csv files accessed on glimmer. Am I right in assuming that this
is because this particular file includes a column with a long text field?
b) when I include the  fileEncoding='ISO-8859-1' argument locally on my Windows machine
and do runApp the app works fine and, in fact, loads much more quickly both than before andthan  on glimmer.
  However, if I just want to load the file to work on in RStudio I need to exclude the argument
otherwise I get the error
"Warning in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  :
  invalid input found on input connection '../CRANpackages.csv'"
